note: Rider lane 9 (2026-09-29): blocks for printed lines that were GM riders.

JESTER_BASE_DELIVER_THE_PUNCHLINE.why: New Jester packets: Flustered penalizes the next actual attack or ability check, then retains Reaction denial until expiry.

tianxia.talent.equipment.mountain_patter.why: Once per round, medium or heavy armor, not Incapacitated: bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage reduced by PB; one passive Equipment reduction per damage (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py).

tianxia.talent.equipment.circuit_armor.why: While the circuit is awake (1 minute): once per round, damage reduced by the key ability modifier (minimum 1); it ends when you are Incapacitated (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py).

tianxia.talent.equipment.beast_hide_harn.why: Padded Layers also reduces slashing damage while wearing leather, hide, scale, lamellar, padded or robe-style armor, still once per round (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py).

tianxia.talent.equipment.qi_conductive_l.why: Once per turn, CP spent on an Equipment talent while armored gives Temporary HP equal to PB (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py).

tianxia.talent.equipment.black_armor_leg.why: Temporary HP equal to PB + key modifier (minimum 1) when the fight begins, while armored (combat/ext/equipment_armor.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.a_fine_display.why: A Strike the Fool Punchline: the Jester's Reaction when its Foil attacks it (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.banquet_escape.why: A Strike the Fool Punchline: move half Speed, a miss if out of reach, else 2d6 + CHA less damage (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.pratfall_exit.why: Falling Prone: a 5-foot move without Opportunity Attacks, once per round (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.focused_applause.why: A Punchline's miss or Prone gives back Martial Focus (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.false_opening.why: The 'False Opening (-2 AC)' choice and its first-miss benefit (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.grand_entrance.why: A free Set the Scene on your first turn (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.jester.mock_praise_script.why: Set the Scene with two Propositions (combat/ext/jester_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.shield.smashing_counter.why: Deflect: a Shove after a missed attack Active Defense answered (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_HEAVEN_REBUKING_BASH.why: One more effect after a successful Smashing Counter (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_RAIN_ON_THE_LOTUS_DEFLECTION.why: Deflect: send a missed projectile back (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_PUNCH_BLOCK.why: An Unarmed Strike roll in place of AC (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.shield.sacrificial_shield.why: Deflect: break the Shield to make a critical hit normal (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_GREATER_DEFLECT.why: Two Deflects for Martial Focus (combat/ext/shield_riders.py); the plug-in owns the payment, so do not attach the older GM modifier to Active Defense.

TAL_SHIELD_BLOCKADE.why: Active Defense on a Dexterity save for half damage (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_REACTIVE_DEFENSE.why: After the Dodge action, one melee counter against a creature that misses (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_SHIELD_OF_THE_SECOND_ANSWER.why: An echo: the next attack meets +2 AC without a Reaction (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_SHIELD_MOUNTAIN_ROOTED_RIM.why: Reduce forced movement and resist Prone after Active Defense (combat/ext/shield_riders.py); do not also execute the older modifier's mistranslated immediate push.

TAL_SHIELD_COVER_ALLY.why: Cover Ally's Reaction row compiles; Extensive Defense reaches covered allies (combat/ext/shield_riders.py).

TAL_FATE_SUBVERT_HARM.why: Reaction as a creature would deal damage: it deals the damage to itself on a failed Charisma save, or the damage drops by the Fate Die (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

TAL_FATE_BORROWED_LIFESPAN_TALISMAN.why: Once per protected creature; the cost is chosen after the Reaction (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

TAL_FATE_MARKED_BY_THE_LEDGER.why: A Bonus Action moves the mark after its creature drops to 0 HP (combat/ext/fate_riders.py).

ICE_BASE_SPENDING_A_FRACTURE_MARK.why: The Fracture Responses at their triggers, once per round (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

ICE_BASE_CRYSTALLIZE_PATH.why: A creature moving 10 feet across your Lattice Spaces gains a Fracture Mark (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_NINEFOLD_CRACK_CALCULATION.why: A second response on the same event for 1 CP (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_RIME_HOOK.why: After Catch Step or Shatter Space the target is dragged across the lattice (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_DIAMOND_RIME_BODY.why: New packets ask where to create the optional melee-hit Lattice Space; the Crystal Guard exemption is retained by its owned condition.

TAL_ICE_FROZEN_MERIDIAN_BIND.why: After Catch Step near your lattice: Strength save or Restrained (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_MIRROR_SLICK_FLOOR.why: A creature marked for crossing your lattice saves or falls Prone (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_WINTER_STORES_THE_BLOW.why: Reaction: damage on your lattice is stored for the next shatter (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_WHITE_STEP_COUNTER.why: Reaction: a creature leaving the ground near your lattice gains a Fracture Mark (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

TAL_ICE_FROZEN_RIVER_REVERSAL.why: Reaction: a marked creature sliding between Lattice Spaces is returned (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py).

tianxia.talent.ice.nascent_soul_glacier_.why: Lattice Limit + PB, one more Fracture Mark (combat/ext/ice_fracture.py, ice_lattice.py).

tianxia.talent.hunger.marrow_furnace_pul.why: PB Temporary HP once per turn when CP goes into a Hunger talent while the Mantle lasts (combat/ext/hunger_riders.py). From a demon-beast Mantle it is instead your PB on one damage roll that turn, and 1 Impurity when the Mantle ends, which is why this row reads the kind of Satiety the Mantle burns.

tianxia.talent.hunger.bitter_medicine_be.why: 1 CP: PB Temporary HP after a successful save against Poisoned (combat/ext/hunger_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.hunger.the_empty_bowl_wat.why: Taste the Qi on a Bloodied or Poisoned creature gives PB Temporary HP once a round (combat/ext/hunger_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.karma.borrowed_tomorrow.why: Reaction: a failed save succeeds, or 1 HP instead of 0 (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.karma.fate_deferred.why: Reaction: damage that would drop a creature waits until the end of its next turn (combat/ext/karma_riders.py).

GLASS_BASE_REFRACTION_RESPONSES.why: Turn the Angle, Visible Crack, Bitter Edge and Shatter Warning at their triggers (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_LENS_OF_STORED_PRESSURE.why: After Turn the Angle, the next Faultline Strike or Glass Shard hit adds damage (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_LIVING_PANE_SUTRA.why: Once a fight, 1 HP instead of 0 while the body is tempered (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_CAREFUL_FEET_ON_BROKEN_LIGHT.why: Your own Shattered Glass Terrain is not difficult for you (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_CLEAN_BREAK.why: Breaking glass you reduce to 0 HP: its three printed answers, asked (combat/ext/glass_pane.py).

TAL_GLASS_REFRACTION_OF_THE_OBVIOUS_BLOW.why: A marked creature that misses you answers to one Refraction Response without spending your Reaction, once per round (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_FAULTLINE_TRANSFER.why: Spending a Faultline Mark may move one other mark once per round (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_WALKING_PANE_BODY.why: The Faultline Mark a melee hit earns you, and the Temporary HP spending it pays (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_TEN_ANGLE_REFRACTION.why: Spending a mark lets one ally step 5 feet out of the marked creature's reach (combat/ext/glass_refraction.py).

TAL_GLASS_PANE_STEP_PROJECTION.why: When you create a projected Glass Pane, it may rise within 10 feet of you without anchoring to a solid surface, and then collapses at the end of your next turn (asked; combat/ext/glass_pane.py).

TAL_RETRIBUTION_HEADFAKE.why: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage while you hold Martial Focus (combat/ext/retribution_riders.py).

EARTH_BASE_SPENDING_A_BURDEN_MARK.why: The Earth Responses at their triggers, once per round (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

TAL_EARTH_SINKING_FOOT_REBUKE.why: An extra effect after Anchor Step or Drag Down (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

TAL_EARTH_LANDSLIDE_ARGUMENT.why: A marked creature crossing your Foundation slides (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).

TAL_EARTH_THE_GRAVE_REFUSES_THE_STEP.why: Reaction, 2 CP: a teleport out of your Foundation meets a Charisma save (combat/ext/earth_responses.py).
